name: API-get-user
description: Retrieve a user by ID.

name: API-get-users
description: List all users.

start_cursor.description: Page cursor from a previous response; omit for the first page.

name: API-get-self
description: Retrieve the bot user for your token.

name: API-post-search
description: Search pages and data sources by title.

query.description: Text matched against page and database titles.

anyOf.description: Result order. Only timestamp `last_edited_time` is supported. If omitted, most recently edited results come first.
Limit results to only pages or only data sources. The only supported property is `object`.

property.description: Property to filter by; only `object` (the object type) is allowed.

start_cursor.description: Page cursor from a previous response; omit for the first page.

name: API-get-block-children
description: List the child blocks of a block.

start_cursor.description: Page cursor from a previous response; omit for the first page.

name: API-patch-block-children
description: Append child blocks to a block or page.

block_id.description: Block ID; a page ID also works.

children.description: Block objects to append to the container block.

after.description: ID of an existing block to append the new blocks after.

name: API-retrieve-a-block
description: Retrieve a single block.

name: API-update-a-block
description: Update a block's content, or archive/restore it.

anyOf.description: The block `type` key with the fields to update. Only `text` (for supported block types) and `checked` (for `to_do` blocks) can be updated.

archived.description: true archives (deletes) the block, false restores it.

name: API-delete-a-block
description: Delete a block.

name: API-retrieve-a-page
description: Retrieve a page.

filter_properties.description: Page property IDs to limit the response to, e.g. `?filter_properties=iAk8&filter_properties=b7dh`.

name: API-patch-page
description: Update a page's properties, icon, cover or trash state.

page_id.description: ID of the page to update.

anyOf.description: Property values to update, keyed by property name or ID. Properties not included are unchanged.
Page icon: an external file object or emoji object.
Cover image; only external file objects are supported.

name: API-post-page
description: Create a page.

anyOf.description: Property values for the new page, keyed by property name or ID.

children.description: Page content as an array of block objects.

icon.description: Page icon: an emoji object or external file object.

cover.description: Cover image, as a file object.

name: API-retrieve-a-page-property
description: Retrieve one property item of a page.

page_size.description: For paginated properties: max property items per page. Default 100.

name: API-retrieve-a-comment
description: List comments on a block or page.

start_cursor.description: Page cursor from a previous response; omit for the first page.

name: API-create-a-comment
description: Create a comment on a page.

name: API-query-data-source
description: Query a data source's pages with filters and sorts.

filter_properties.description: Page property value IDs to limit the response to.

name: API-retrieve-a-data-source
description: Retrieve a data source.

name: API-update-a-data-source
description: Update a data source.

name: API-create-a-data-source
description: Create a data source.

anyOf.description: Property schema of the data source.

name: API-list-data-source-templates
description: List the templates in a data source.

name: API-retrieve-a-database
description: Retrieve a database.

name: API-move-page
description: Move a page to a new parent.

name: API-retrieve-page-markdown
description: Read a page's content as Markdown. Errors: 403 integration lacks the read/update content capability; 404 page not found or not shared with the integration; 429 rate limited.

page_id.description: Notion page (or block) ID to read or update as markdown.

include_transcript.description: Include meeting note transcripts. If false (default), shows a placeholder with the meeting note URL.

name: API-update-page-markdown
description: Edit a page's content as Markdown. Errors: 403 integration lacks the read/update content capability; 404 page not found or not shared with the integration; 409 conflict (e.g. row limit exceeded); 429 rate limited.

page_id.description: Notion page (or block) ID to read or update as markdown.

type.description: Edit kind. Prefer `replace_content` (overwrite the page) or `update_content` (targeted find-and-replace); `insert_content` and `replace_content_range` are deprecated.

anyOf.description: For type `replace_content`: replaces the whole page.

new_str.description: Full new page content as enhanced Markdown.

allow_deleting_content.description: Allow deleting child pages/databases missing from the new content.

content_updates.description: Up to 100 edits, applied in order.

replace_all_matches.description: Replace every match of old_str, not just the first (default false).

allow_deleting_content.description: Allow deleting child pages/databases removed by the edits.

anyOf.description: Deprecated. For type `insert_content`: inserts Markdown at a position.

after.description: Ellipsis selection ("start text...end text") to insert after. Not with position.

position.description: Insert at page start or end. Not with after.

anyOf.description: Deprecated. For type `replace_content_range`: replaces a selected Markdown range.

content_range.description: Ellipsis selection ("start text...end text") of the range to replace.

allow_deleting_content.description: Allow deleting child pages/databases inside the replaced range.
